labels.ac: Classifier: big for a parsed failure in an untouched file whatever the job is named
labels.desc: A free word like format/lint/drift in a test's own log, or a job named lint-and-test, made a failing test in untouched code classify small; mechanical matching needed anchored signatures, step-name only, and parsed test files deciding first.

labels.ac: Status: a failing log fetch keeps the PR red and big
labels.desc: A gh run view --log-failed error was unhandled in the failing-detail read, so a red PR crashed or could not stay red and big.

labels.ac: Status: a gh failure after the first read is pending; a missing gh is none while an unusable one is cannot_run
labels.desc: A gh failure or malformed gh output while polling was not distinguished (first read unusable vs later read pending), so a red PR could read as none/no CI.

labels.ac: Status: an unusable gh is cannot_run (exit 2)
labels.desc: An unexpected crash in ci_gate.py exited 1 (read as red) instead of 2 cannot_run; no top-level handler existed.

labels.ac: Fix path and wiring: exit 2 halts [CI-RED] could not check
labels.desc: 4a step 8, 3z Step 3A and the reference did not state that exit 2 from status or cap halts as [CI-RED] could not check.

labels.ac: Fix path and wiring: the 2-commit single round with re-check at --attempt 2
labels.desc: The status run used an undefined <k> attempt and the one-fix-round rule was unclear; 4a and 3z now pin --attempt 1 then --attempt 2 and at most 2 commits in one round.

labels.ac: Fix path and wiring: order is suite record, commit, cap, floor guard, push, re-check
labels.desc: The 3z dispatch to the 3d implementer did not instruct recording the full suite (test_gate.py record --suite) before the fix commit.

labels.ac: Constitution: AGENTS.md section 4 sentence; 3z delegates the fix to a 3d implementer that only commits
labels.desc: The CI-fix exception sentence said the 3z implementer may commit and push; it must say the implementer only commits and ship-only pushes.

labels.ac: Status: reports base_stale; Classifier: big for a stale base
labels.desc: No test proved base_stale is reported by status, that a stale base classifies big, or that _base_is_stale reads real git history.

labels.ac: Time-to-Value: the post-PR wait is one blocking call run with the host's maximum tool timeout
labels.desc: 4a step 7/8 and the reference did not tell the agent to run status with the host maximum tool timeout (600000) or --wait below the host limit.
